guard_streams.source: Latest telecoms and pay-TV complaints revealed - Q3 2025
guard_streams.write_limit: Provider-level complaint volumes and complaint-handling findings are service-quality evidence; they do not establish fixed-broadband availability, orderability or parcel-measured speed.

facts.detail: Ofcom published the Q3 2025 complaints update on 19 February 2026.
The page was last updated on 8 May 2026.
The figures cover the third quarter of 2025, from July through September.
Complaint levels for broadband, landline, mobile and pay-TV remained similar to the prior quarter.
EE, TalkTalk and Vodafone generated the most broadband complaints.
Plusnet generated the fewest broadband complaints.
TalkTalk generated the most landline complaints.
Utility Warehouse generated the fewest landline complaints.
O2, Sky Mobile and Three were the most complained-about pay-monthly mobile providers.
Ofcom publishes aggregate complaint figures to understand dissatisfaction and support consumer choice, not to resolve individual complaints.

guard_streams.source: Bulletin: BDUK delivery performance, annual: April 2024 to March 2025
guard_streams.write_limit: Annual subsidy-delivery statistics are official aggregate programme outputs; they cannot establish live orderability or measured performance for a selected parcel without an exact current premises join.

facts.detail: The April 2024 to March 2025 bulletin is the first annual release in this official-statistics series.
BDUK estimated 152,700 premises received gigabit-capable coverage during 2024/25.
The cumulative estimate reached 1,227,000 premises since the gigabit programmes began.
GIS gigabit contracts accounted for 41 percent, or 62,760 premises.
Vouchers accounted for 37 percent, or 55,740 premises.
Superfast and Hubs accounted for 22 percent, or 34,200 premises.
Rural areas accounted for 89 percent, or 135,900 premises.
Residential premises accounted for 91 percent, or 139,000 premises.
England recorded 67 percent of delivery, or 101,800 premises.
The bulletin states the statistics are official statistics produced under the Code of Practice for Statistics.
